competitors.name: Katie's Pizza & Pasta
competitors.action: Katie's continued scaling its handmade frozen pizza brand after landing nationwide Target distribution, with PMQ highlighting a 400,000-pizza production sprint to support the rollout. That is a strong signal that premium, restaurant-origin frozen pizza can win true mass-retail placement when the story and operations are sharp enough.

competitors.name: Pizza Freak Co.
competitors.action: Chef-led frozen pizza brand Pizza Freak Co. launched an AI Chef tool built around customizing its frozen pies, adding a new kind of CPG differentiation: software and guided remixing layered on top of the product itself instead of relying only on flavor or packaging claims.

competitors.name: Milton's Craft Bakers
competitors.action: Milton's launched a BBQ Chicken with Jalapeños and Red Onions Cauliflower Crust Pizza exclusively at Sprouts nationwide, showing the better-for-you frozen pizza lane is still leaning on retailer-exclusive flavor innovation rather than plain health messaging alone.

trends.topic: Frozen pizza brands are widening the playbook beyond product alone
trends.magnitude: Today's cleanest signals were Target-scale expansion for a restaurant-origin brand, AI-led consumer customization from a chef-driven frozen label, and a spicy retailer-exclusive BFY launch at Sprouts.
trends.context: Real Dough should keep thinking beyond flavor drops. The aisle is rewarding brands that pair a specific product story with a specific go-to-market mechanic: mass-retail proof, merchandisable exclusives, or interactive brand engagement.

market_data.value: 400,000 handmade frozen pizzas produced in 96 days
market_data.change: Supports nationwide Target distribution and confirms real scale appetite for premium restaurant-origin frozen pizza

market_data.value: Frozen pies built for AI-guided customization and ready in about 25 minutes
market_data.change: Signals a shift toward software-assisted engagement layered onto premium frozen pizza CPG

market_data.value: Nationwide Sprouts placement for a new cauliflower crust BBQ chicken SKU
market_data.change: Retailer-exclusive BFY pizza innovation continues to show up through flavor and heat, not just nutrition claims

breaking.headline: The strongest signal today is that frozen pizza winners are pairing product with a distribution or engagement mechanic: Target scale, retailer exclusives, or software-driven customization.
breaking.impact: Real Dough should keep its sourdough quality story tight, but also think in channel mechanics: exclusive drops, sharper retail stories, and simple ways shoppers can participate or personalize.
